content:
Someone once told me,

“Rank se kuch nahi hota.”

I smiled and replied,

“Aankhein band karne se sach badal nahi jaata.”

Yes, it’s true.

A rank doesn’t define your potential.

Plenty of successful CAs were never rank holders.

But let’s not pretend a rank doesn’t matter.

Recruiters notice it.
Rankers often receive higher salary offers.
They get more interview calls.

They have access to opportunities that may not be available to everyone at the start.

The initial salary gap can be significant, along with added recognition and credibility.

Does that mean your career is over if you don’t get a rank?

Absolutely not.

In the long run, your skills, consistency, and work ethic matter far more.

But in the beginning, a rank gives you a head start.

And there’s nothing wrong with acknowledging that reality.
